narrative.intro: Ram System Gmbh has $487M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Ram System Gmbh recorded 8 awards in the period, with an average award size of $60.9M and obligations up 10.5% year over year. Ram System Gmbh’s FY2026 total is a partial, fiscal year to date figure and aligns with prior-year obligations of $136M in FY21, $6M in FY22, $680M in FY23, $11.9M in FY24, and $441M in FY25. Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Manufacturing is the primary NAICS market for Ram System Gmbh with $487M in obligations. Ram System Gmbh also lists Bare Printed Circuit Board Manufacturing as a secondary NAICS line, with a negative obligation indicated. This summary presents the company’s award count, average award size, year-over-year change, multi-year obligation history, and top NAICS positions in a numbers-first format.
